sentimentHistoryExamples.heading: 2020 and 2022: SIO showed extreme fear near market bottoms
sentimentHistoryExamples.intro: During the 2020 pandemic crash and the 2022 bear market, SIO reached very low scores near market bottoms. Compare sentiment with SPY to see the long-term entry opportunities that emerged during deep fear.
sentimentHistoryExamples.chartDescription: SIO scores and SPY closing prices from {{start}} to {{end}}. Both panels share the date axis. Orange markers show {{count}} historical sentiment lows.
sentimentHistoryExamples.markerLabel: Orange marks: historical sentiment lows (marked in hindsight)

pandemic.label: 2020 pandemic shock
pandemic.title: 2020: extreme fear around the pandemic bottom
pandemic.reading: When SPY bottomed on March 23, 2020, SIO was already at about 1.5. It fell to 0.6 on April 7. Very low scores clustered around the crash bottom and early rebound, helping you identify long-term entry opportunities during market fear.

tightening.label: 2022 market correction
tightening.title: 2022: October’s low score came near the bear-market bottom
tightening.reading: SIO fell to about 4.2 on October 3, 2022; SPY bottomed on October 12. Low scores also appeared in July and at year-end. If you are looking to build a position in stages, these readings help identify periods of extreme market fear.
